intro: A glass of air cincau from a stall is about 120 kcal (estimate). Almost all of it comes from the sugar syrup. The cincau jelly itself is very low in calories.
diet: Yes. Air cincau isn't that high in calories compared to milky drinks. But it's almost all sugar, with no protein. Fine once in a while on a hot day. Better to go less sweet.
tips: Make it at home: diced canned cincau, cold water, a little sugar.
Pick the small size if there's a choice.

swap.name: Cincau, less sweet
swap.why: You still get the cincau taste with almost half the sugar. Saves about 50 kcal.

faq.a: Black cincau is made from the leaves of the cincau plant. They're boiled and set into a jelly.

faq.q: Is it true air cincau cools the body?
faq.a: Many Malaysians drink cincau to feel refreshed in hot weather. It's more of a traditional belief, with no strong scientific proof.

faq.q: Is canned cincau the same as stall cincau?
faq.a: More or less. Canned cincau is usually just the jelly, so you control how much sugar goes in.
